system.description:
“In the snow, every step is tells a tale.” While other hunters rely on a frantic chase, your art is the patient calculus of the frozen north. You are a tracker, and frost is your greatest ally. You don’t outrun your quarry; you let the creeping cold you command slow their escape, turning any battlefield into your personal tundra until they can run no more.

LEVEL 3

Arctic Survivalist.

You have resistance to Cold damage and you ignore Slowed Terrain created by ice or snow. You can also endure extreme cold without penalty.

Northern Hunter.

Your attacks against your quarry now apply Slowed, 1 turn, and damage from your Hunter’s Mark can be Cold damage.

LEVEL 7

Enchanted Frost.

When you hit your quarry, you can spend 1 ToTH charge to inflict Restrained, 1 round. Enemies adjacent to your target are Slowed, 1 turn.

LEVEL 11

Winter’s Bite.

(1/turn) Whenever you deal Cold damage, the target and all adjacent enemies take WIL Cold damage. Ignores armor.

LEVEL 15

True Ice.

When you use Enchanted Frost, you can spend 1 more ToTH to inflict Stunned and your quarry also gains vulnerability to Cold damage for 1 minute.

Thrill of the Hunt options:

  • Icy Shot. (Half range) 1 Action. Attack with a ranged weapon, add 1d8+WIL Cold damage.
  • Frozen Ground. 2 Actions, Range: 8, Blast: 3. The area becomes Slowed Terrain for 1 minute. Creatures that enter a space must succeed a DEX save or fall Prone.
  • Rimebind Shot. (Half range) 1 Action. Attack with a ranged weapon, on hit, their speed is reduced to 0 for 2 rounds or until they make a STR save on their turn.
  • Heart of Ice. Free Reaction: When you Defend. Gain WIL+LVL temp HP and the attacker takes Cold damage equal to the temp HP lost.
  • Cleansing Cold. Free Action. Take 1d4 Cold damage and remove a negative condition (not including Wounds).
  • Fracturing Cold. 1 Action. Make an attack with a Ranged or Melee weapon. If your target is Slowed, remove Slowed and deal +2d10 Cold damage.
